faces.transcription: Open Door 46. Then open Door F and place that rule in the rulebook. Then draw the Pause card in the Legacy deck and read the back of it.
faces.flavor: The Soviets proved easy to locate, as if they weren't expecting opposition. Your teams made a quick sweep and prevented the experiment from taking place. Quick analysis suggests that the Soviets were holding the trials around city parks.
